about.heroSubtitle: Prima Institute was founded on a simple belief: that rigorous, hands-on training by real industry professionals produces extraordinary graduates.
about.missionTitle: We Exist to Transform Passion Into Profession
about.missionPara1: Since 2011, Prima Institute has been the creative home for aspiring chefs, baristas, makeup artists, fashion designers, and tech professionals across Ethiopia and beyond.
about.missionPara2: Our programmes combine classical foundations with modern industry practice. Students learn from instructors who are still active in the field — chefs who cook in top restaurants, makeup artists who work at fashion events, designers who build real collections.
about.missionPara3: We keep our classes small intentionally. With a maximum of 15 students per cohort, every student receives genuine mentorship, not just instruction.
about.value1Desc: We measure success by what our graduates can do, not the paper they hold. Skills and portfolio are our metrics.
about.value2Desc: Our curriculum is built with working professionals, ensuring everything taught is directly applicable on day one.
about.value3Desc: Our instructors and students come from across the globe. Different backgrounds create richer learning environments.
about.value4Desc: Graduation is not the end. Our alumni network, mentorship programmes, and industry events keep the Prima family connected.
about.milestone1: Prima Institute founded with a single Culinary Arts cohort of 8 students.
about.milestone2: Expanded into Food & Drinks with launch of Barista and Mixology programmes.
about.milestone3: Beauty & Makeup division launched; Nadia Khalil joins as Lead Artist.
about.milestone4: Fashion Design programme introduced. Yuki Tanaka joins as Design Director.
about.milestone5: Passed 2,000 graduates. New studio campus opens in Addis Ababa.
about.milestone6: Launched scholarship programme and Computer Training division for aspiring students.
about.ctaSubtitle: Join thousands of successful graduates who transformed their passion into a thriving career at Prima Institute.
